summary.text: Cindy Crawford, a Republican, represents Arkansas House District 51 in Sebastian County, which includes a section of Fort Smith and the surrounding areas in Barling and Fort Chaffee; she is serving her fourth term.

paragraphs.text: A native of the Greater Fort Smith area, she began volunteering at the Pregnancy Crisis Center in 1990 and became its director.
In 1994 she started Tree of Life Preventive Health Maintenance, Inc., a nonprofit, and was CEO of its Hannah House, a home for girls that opened in 1997, for 23 years.
She ran for the House in 2018 and began her first term in 2019.
